description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the Subjects interface, managing a collection of Subject objects. It includes methods to create, retrieve, modify, and serialize subjects, with support for JSON serialization/deserialization and ensuring immutability.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjects
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Subjects interface, providing methods for managing a collection of Subject objects in a thread-safe, unmodifiable manner.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableSubjects instance from an iterable of Subject objects, ensuring each Subject has a unique ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableSubjects instance from a JSON object, parsing JSON fields into Subject objects.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves a Subject by its SubjectId, returning an Optional containing the Subject if found.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Returns a new Subjects instance with the specified Subject added or replaced.

methods.name: removeSubject
methods.description: Returns a new Subjects instance excluding the Subject with the specified SubjectId.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of subjects stored.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no subjects stored.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Subjects collection into a JSON object, applying provided schema version and predicate filters.
